entry.title: The Words Engraved In Your Sword(Heart)
entry.summary:
Author: Stolen_Kid

Rating: General AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 4,174Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 11

Summary: Arthur favors the color blue more than he ever did red or gold. With how often he spots it around Camelot the prince should consider blue something mundane. He has seen the color in every shade, on various persons and animals. There is nothing special about blue, it is one of the most ordinary colors in the world. In some ways, Arthur knows that is the reason he likes the color so much. It paints the sky, the place where heaven meets earth and under which he trained a new generation of knights. It’s the color of his favorite lake, of the mountains looking over him in the distance, of fields of wildflowers, of his mothers adoring gaze looking down at him from a portrait. But recently blue looks like a faded tunic paired with a set of eyes crinkled with mirth. It is laughter, kindness, empathy, forgiveness, all things that are long lost in the empty halls of the citadel. It is a stranger that Arthur searches for in every crowd, waiting for their paths to cross once again.
